title: A commit takes only the paths its author names
intention: A commit carries only the paths its author named; another session's staged work in the shared index never rides it, and the shared index is left telling the truth afterwards.
why: Two Claude sessions commit from one working tree and one git index. Measured 2026-10-13: CC staged a one-line edit to cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_address_sieve.py and ran git commit; its pre-commit reseal ran ~3 min; meanwhile the builder committed b0420641 'records: 03ea6f93df03 hollow seal', which swept CC's staged edit under the builder's ticket message; CC's commit then died 'cannot lock ref HEAD: is at b0420641 but expected f05e88c4'. CC's index had also already held two builder-staged files (.artifact-journal.jsonl, cairn/devices/trouble/validations/test_the_store_root_is_a_light_door.json) that CC's commit would have carried. The lived symptom: a commit's message and ticket no longer say what it changed, so history attributes work to the wrong ticket (hollow anchors on '<tk>: build' commits read it). Akien: 'sounds more like a fixit ticket'.
traces_to: Law 6 (each session owns its own writes; a commit is a write to the shared history and must carry only its owner's work) and Law 7 (a commit is a record of truth; one that carries another's change under its message is a permanent mis-record); RULE 1 places the check in cairn/tools/artifact, the commit question both repos' hooks already ask.
how: In cairn/tools/artifact: when the artifact check runs inside a pre-commit hook (GIT_INDEX_FILE set), refuse unless git handed it an --only temp index (basename next-index-*) or a merge/cherry-pick/revert is in progress; the refusal names `git commit -m ... -- <paths>`. Then refresh the shared index for paths the commit wrote whose shared entry still equals the parent's blob (likely an artifact-tracked post-commit hook through cairn/tools/post_commit; measure). Details in builder_check of the sorted berth.
falsifier: Done when, in a scratch repo with both hooks installed: (T1) a plain `git commit` (shared index) is REFUSED with a message naming `git commit -- <paths>`; `git commit -a` likewise; (T2) `git commit -- a` with another path b staged by 'the other session' commits a (plus hook-staged seals and the artifact journal) and leaves b staged and uncommitted; (T3) after T2 the shared index holds no stale pre-commit blob for any path the commit wrote, and b's staged blob is byte-identical to before; (T4) a commit with MERGE_HEAD present is not refused. Hollow build (artifact.py reverted) reds T1 and T3. Wrong-intent signal: the rule chafes legitimate commits often enough that sessions reach for --no-verify — count --no-verify-shaped commits (no artifact journal line staged) for a week after.
builder_notes: A Haiku builder needs: (a) WHERE: cairn/tools/artifact/artifact.py — a new check beside check_staged, called from __main__ 'check' only when GIT_INDEX_FILE is set (i.e. inside a hook; a hand `cairn artifact check` stays unchanged). (b) THE PREDICATE: refuse when basename(GIT_INDEX_FILE) does not start with 'next-index-' and no MERGE_HEAD/CHERRY_PICK_HEAD/REVERT_HEAD exists in the git dir. (c) The message: 'commit names its paths: git commit -m ... -- <paths>; another session's staged work is in this index'. (d) check_staged's own `git add -- .artifact-journal.jsonl` must keep landing in the TEMP index under --only (it inherits GIT_INDEX_FILE; verify). (e) The stale-index refresh (missing_check) and where it fires — measure whether .git/index is locked during the --only pre-commit; if so, post-commit. (f) Proof: cairn/tools/artifact/proofs/test_a_commit_takes_only_the_paths_its_author_names.py, hermetic scratch git repo with the real hook installed via `cairn artifact install-hook`, four teeth T1-T4 as in the falsifier. (g) After PROVED, CC's own habit: every commit `git commit -- <paths>`; the tester's reseal hook already runs inside whatever index git hands it. STALE SHARED INDEX: The stale shared index: after an --only commit the shared .git/index still holds the PRE-commit blob of any path the hook staged into the temp index (measured: 'MM seal' after the commit). A later --only commit never reads it, but `git status` then shows a staged change nobody made — the false reading CC acted on today. So the ticket owns that too: after the commit, a path the commit wrote whose shared-index entry still equals the PARENT's blob is refreshed to HEAD's; a shared-index entry that differs from the parent (another session's staging) is left untouched. Mechanism is the builder's to measure (the shared index may be locked during the commit, so this likely lands as an artifact-tracked post-commit hook fired by the cairn/tools/post_commit fan-out, plus CairnCommons' hook).

decisions.text: D1 (the /sorted builder_check): A Haiku builder needs: (a) WHERE: cairn/tools/artifact/artifact.py — a new check beside check_staged, called from __main__ 'check' only when GIT_INDEX_FILE is set (i.e. inside a hook; a hand `cairn artifact check` stays unchanged). (b) THE PREDICATE: refuse when basename(GIT_INDEX_FILE) does not start with 'next-index-' and no MERGE_HEAD/CHERRY_PICK_HEAD/REVERT_HEAD exists in the git dir. (c) The message: 'commit names its paths: git commit -m ... -- <paths>; another session's staged work is in this index'. (d) check_staged's own `git add -- .artifact-journal.jsonl` must keep landing in the TEMP index under --only (it inherits GIT_INDEX_FILE; verify). (e) The stale-index refresh (missing_check) and where it fires — measure whether .git/index is locked during the --only pre-commit; if so, post-commit.
